israel_entities.scope: Israeli subsidiary of Waters Corporation (parent of the ex-BD businesses since Feb 2026) listed in Waters' 10-K Exhibit 21.1 (FY2011-FY2023 filings); role (sales/service) not stated in the filing

israel_note: CORPORATE STATUS (high confidence): on 9 Feb 2026 Waters Corporation completed the Reverse Morris Trust combination with BD's Biosciences & Diagnostic Solutions businesses (Waters shareholders ~60.8%, BD shareholders ~39.2%; Claire M. Fraser joined the Waters board, now 11 members). Waters reorganised into four divisions: Waters Analytical Sciences, Waters Biosciences (formerly BD Biosciences - flow cytometers such as FACSymphony/FACSDiscover and reagents), Waters Advanced Diagnostics (formerly BD Diagnostic Solutions - BACTEC, BD MAX, Phoenix, Kiestra, women's health) and Waters Materials Sciences. No reporting of delays or problems with the closing was found. BD (NYSE: BDX) continues as a medical-technology company (BD Medical, BD Interventional, specimen management). ISRAEL: (1) BD has its own Israeli footprint - jobs.bd.com carries an Israel location page and search results describe 'BD Caesarea' (ex-Caesarea Medical Electronics) as a BD infusion-pump manufacturing site; BD also ran a Global Enterprise R&D collaboration call with the Israel Innovation Authority (flow cytometry for resource-poor settings, 2017-2018). None of these sources state who sells BD Biosciences/Diagnostics products in Israel. (2) Waters' SEC subsidiary lists (Exhibit 21.1, 2011-2023) include 'Waters (TC) Israel Ltd.', an Israeli Waters subsidiary - the likely future channel for Waters Biosciences/Advanced Diagnostics, but the filing gives no description and no Waters Israel contact page could be opened. (3) Searches for an independent Israeli distributor ('BD Biosciences Israel distributor'; Hebrew 'בקטון דיקינסון ישראל BD פלואו ציטומטריה') found none; the Israeli distributor brand lists that surfaced (Rhenium, Enco, Agentek) do not include BD. (4) bdbiosciences.com / bd.com / waters.com country pages could not be fetched. Most plausible reading: direct sales through the manufacturer's own Israeli entity (historically BD Israel; going forward Waters (TC) Israel Ltd.), but this was not confirmed by a source, hence 'unclear'. Tool limits in this session: the shared web-search budget was exhausted after the first round of searches and all page fetches (WebFetch/curl) were blocked, so manufacturer distributor/contact pages could not be opened and some Hebrew searches could not be run. Size figures marked 'recalled' come from company filings/pages as known to the researcher (knowledge to mid-2026) and were not re-verified against a fetched source.
confidence_note: The Waters-BD combination facts are high confidence (multiple press-release sources dated 9 Feb 2026). Israel channel is unresolved (evidence only of BD's and Waters' Israeli legal entities, not of who sells flow cytometry/diagnostics), and the USD 3.4 bn segment figure is recalled from the deal announcement rather than re-verified.
